title: 3.5.18 Lab: Rewrite a Multi-Parameter Function to Take an Object
description: Take a function with three positional parameters and rewrite it to read one options object instead. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Write the positional original
steps.instructions: Write a function that takes three positional parameters (for example width, height and color) and returns a string built from them.

steps.title: Rewrite it to take one object
steps.instructions: Change the function so it takes a single parameter, an options object, and reads each value off that object with a dot.

steps.title: Call it with an options object
steps.instructions: Call the function, passing one object literal with the three keys named, and print the result.
